description:
Estimate how guessable a password is with zxcvbn pattern matching (dictionary words, common passwords, keyboard walks, sequences, dates, l33t). Returns a 0-4 score, estimated guesses, entropy in bits, crack times for online and offline attacks, warnings, suggestions and NIST SP 800-63B-4 length checks. The password is not echoed back.

Returns: JSON { score 0-4, label, length, guesses, guesses_log10, entropy_bits, character_pool_entropy_bits, character_classes[], crack_times[{scenario, seconds, display}], warning, suggestions[], patterns[{pattern, start, end, description}], nist_sp800_63b{...} }. The password itself is never included.
Example input: {"password":"Tr0ub4dor&3","user_inputs":["alice"]}
On error, includes hint: `password` must be a string of at most 256 characters; `user_inputs` is an optional array of strings.

password.description: The password to analyse (up to 256 characters).

user_inputs.description: Optional personal words (name, username, site name) that make the password easier to guess if it contains them.

name: password_strength
